experiment.title: Synthetic analyzer comparison and table-stress demonstration
experiment.research_question: Can the reporting harness preserve synthetic evidence labels and uncertainty?
experiment.hypothesis: Unknown results remain unscored and synthetic measurements never imply efficacy.
experiment.prespecified_criteria: Check validation, tables, evidence-grade, score threshold boundaries and gates.

commands: uv run --locked python -m python_engineering.reporting build-report examples/synthetic_900.json reports/E-900/synthetic-stress-v1
environment.runtime_identity: isolated macOS worktree; captured before publication; the Git source checkout may be dirty

evidence.note: Constructed synthetic rows are purposely not real analyzer observations. Long wrapped explanatory notes exercise PDF page and table layout and prevent a green-looking report from masquerading as independently verified evidence. Every result is synthetic and must be excluded from adoption decisions.
Official renderer capability documentation; not an observation or tool efficacy oracle.

criteria.question: What fraction of flagged cases have seeded defects?
What is the candidate median execution time in ms?

gates.note: No independent or real experimental evidence
Simulation does not run a real upstream tool

interpretation.summary: Artificial run used exclusively to verify the reporting implementation.
limitations: All observed numbers and defect labels are generated, not tool measurements.
Repeated or paired rows are synthetic; no generalization or statistical inference.
Upstream identity is intentionally fictional and nonqualified.
interpretation.applicability: PDF/Markdown renderer, validation, page flow, missing evidence and score mechanics only
interpretation.proposed_next_step: Independent review and real frozen protocol-scoped experimental run.
